description: This file defines a trait 'SignatureTrait' used for signature calculation in AWS Signature V4, including caching mechanisms for signing keys.

methods.name: createScope
methods.description: Generates a scope string for AWS Signature V4 based on short date, region, and service.

methods.name: getSigningKey
methods.description: Computes and caches the signing key used for AWS Signature V4, based on short date, region, service, and secret key.
